games.name: [UPD] Mine ⛏️
games.desc:
Welcome to Mine, the most relaxing mining game on Roblox! ⛏️

Step into the world of Mine, where skill, strategy, and discovery drive your journey. Dig through layers of rock, uncover legendary and unique ores, and piece together the mysteries hidden beneath the surface! Currently there are 200,000+ different variations of minerals. There is more than enough to uncover!

How To Mine?:
- Hold out your pickaxe inside of a mine and hold down [LMB] on a block
- Stop holding when your moving bar is close to the white bar. Try to get it as close as possible!
- It's okay if you miss a few times! It takes practice.
- The closer you get to the white bar, the greater your damage & reward once broken!

Redeem codes in the settings menu! (Gear at the top right of your screen/[M] for PC)

Credits to:
• @Timpy23 - Creator / Developer
• @ReViVeDzz - Music & OST
• All QA Testers & Contributors involved
• Special thanks to you for playing!

Inspired by Fisch & Azure Mines

games.name: Da Hoods
games.desc:
A difficult game, read below for tips.
Account has to be at least 10 days to play.

[Controls] F - Block E - Stomp G - Carry LCTRL - Crouch
You can weave 100% if you time at the right time when blocking.

To gain muscle buy weights at Hood-Fitness.
Eat lettuce to reduce muscle.

Cop: To join you need 0 bounties and go to the police station, if you execute anyone without cuffs you'll be automatically kicked off. Use the cuffs instead.

Criminal: Ransack banks and several other small-time shops in order to gain Wanted and Cash.

Gun saves - however, can be lost by death, or logging when KO, or 0 ammo.

Can only drop 70% of the cash. (Min: 100 Max: 10,000)

Game-Command: "/e stats"
